mapper.insert: insert into risk_event ( company_id, event_type, event_title, event_content, event_date, amount, severity, is_read, is_handled, data_source, external_id, create_time ) values ( #{companyId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTitle}, #{eventContent}, #{eventDate}, #{amount}, #{severity}, #{isRead}, #{isHandled}, #{dataSource}, #{externalId}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from risk_event where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select * from risk_event where company_id = #{companyId} order by event_date desc
SELECT event_type as eventType, COUNT(*) as count FROM risk_event GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(event_date, '%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM risk_event WHERE event_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(event_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risk_event WHERE is_read = 0
